From requirements to understanding

How Rovi should behave.

Read the intent first. Open a scenario for a concrete example. Follow the verification map to see how the behavior must be checked.

A small reading key

Requirement

A rule the product must satisfy. “SHALL” and “MUST” mean required.

Scenario

Given = starting conditions.
When = an action or event.
Then = the expected result.

Evidence

A planned check is not a passing test. Laptop tests and physical acceptance are separate.

Task boxes are read-only and mirror the source. A completed planning document does not mean the product is implemented.
